title: Imperfect of εἰμί
subtitle: Read ἦν and its high-frequency companions.
overview: The imperfect of εἰμί is irregular and extraordinarily frequent. Learn its most visible forms as sight vocabulary.
ἐστιν normally has present time in the indicative; ἦν normally signals past time.

items.en: In the beginning was the Word.

items.grc: ἦν ὁ Ἰωάννης ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.
